query:
UPDATE "Node"
                   SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'MAINTENANCE'::"NodeStatus"
                                     THEN status ELSE 'ONLINE'::"NodeStatus" END,
                       "lastCheckAt" = $2, "lastPingMs" = $3,
                       version = COALESCE($4, version),
                       "xrayVersion" = $5, "singboxVersion" = $6,
                       "updatedAt" = $2
                   WHERE id = $1
